annotations.title: Change a project held in a state token

description: Changes a My Project project carried in a state token (cqp1.…, from a project file answer): add or remove a room or space, change a dimension, add or remove a takeoff or calculator line, change a roof pitch, rename. Rebuilds every line and returns the new token, a short diff, the totals and a site link. The token is compressed, not encrypted; nothing is stored. No prices.

detail.description: full (the default): the whole answer. summary: the result lines, the citation line and the page only — fewer tokens to read.

file.description: true: the updated My Project file as well.

operations.description: The changes, applied in order (0 to 20); none returns the project as the token holds it.

inputUnits.description: Send "base" to pass bare numbers on dimensioned inputs in base units (m, m², L, kg …), as the published test vectors are written. Without it a length, area or volume must carry its unit.

inputs.description: The calculator's input values, by input id (an unknown id is refused with the accepted ids). A length, area, volume or other measured input takes "12 ft", "3.5 m", "8' 3 1/2\"" or {"value": 12, "unit": "ft"}; a count or percentage takes a number; a select takes one of its option values. Inputs left out take the value the calculator's page opens on.

label.description: The line's name in the project; the calculator's title when left out.

slug.description: The calculator's slug, such as concrete-calculator.

field.description: set_dimension: the figure's id (a space's figure, a calculator's input, a takeoff's measurement, a house's value).

index.description: Which space, calculator, takeoff or house, counting from 0 (default 0).

op.description: add_space (space) and remove_space (index) on a plan; set_dimension (target, index, field, value) on a space's figure, a calculator's input, a takeoff's measurement or a house's figure; add_takeoff (takeoff) and remove_takeoff (index or takeoff id); add_calculator (calculator) and remove_calculator (index); set_roof_pitch (pitch) on a plan's roof or a house; rename (name).

pitch.description: set_roof_pitch: rise in 12 (a plan's roof takes 0 to 24; a house 4, 6, 8, 10 or 12).

space.description: add_space: one space as a plan takes it (kind, figures, doors, windows, finishes …).

allowances.description: Row → an allowance the reader sets: a percentage (cutting waste, overlap), or the option an allowance follows (a lay pattern). Row names are the takeoff's steps (the calculator slug, or the step key where one runs twice).

inputUnits.description: Send "base" to pass bare numbers on dimensioned inputs in base units (m, m², L, kg …), as the published test vectors are written. Without it a length, area or volume must carry its unit.

leaveOut.description: Rows the reader leaves out of the job: still worked and shown, not put in the project or counted in labour.

measurements.description: Measurement id → value, each length, area or volume with its unit ("12 ft", {"value": 3.6, "unit": "m"}); counts as numbers. Ids are those of the takeoff; any left out opens at the page's own figure.

selection.description: Build-up choice id → option id, the takeoff's own (a stud size, an insulation, a cladding). Choices left out take the page's own for the system.

takeoff.description: add_takeoff: a takeoff and its measurements; remove_takeoff: a takeoff id.

target.description: set_dimension: what the figure belongs to.

token.description: A project state token from a project-file answer or an earlier update.

name: update_project

applied.description: Each operation as it was applied.

diff.description: What the operations changed, line by line (lines that share a zone, a name and a unit are summed).

link.description: Opens the project on the site from the token, carried in the address fragment, which a browser does not send to any server.

anyOf.description: The project's inputs, deflated and base64url-encoded with a format version and a CRC-32 check (cqp1.…). Compact, not encrypted: anyone who has it can read it.

citation.description: The one citation line, built from the answer's own data.

lines.description: The result lines, as the report's table gives them.

notes.description: What a professional must decide, when to call one, a false-friend warning, that adoption is local: kept in every summary.
